description:
Optional final cleanup. After enough time has passed (60-90 days post
Phase 5) that you are confident no external link, fork, or PyPI
consumer depends on the archived joeharris76/benchbox-private repo, and
no in-flight work is hiding in the retired local clone, the archive can
be deleted and the local clone removed.

This is intentionally low priority and deferred. The archive costs
nothing to keep; deleting it is irreversible. Default action is to
leave it forever as a historical reference - this TODO exists only
in case you want to clean up later.

Note: under Option B there is no joeharris76/BenchBox-archive (no rename
happened); the archive being decommissioned here is
joeharris76/benchbox-private (the original private repo).

Plan file: /Users/joe/.claude/plans/single-repo-migration.md (Phase 9).

anti_patterns.dont: delete the archive if forks of benchbox-private exist (unlikely for a private repo)
anti_patterns.why: users who forked from the old URL will lose their fork's upstream.

anti_patterns.dont: delete the retired private clone before w2 confirms no uncommitted/unpushed work exists
anti_patterns.why: that work is irrecoverable if the GitHub-side archive has also been deleted.
the archive costs nothing to keep, and deletion is irreversible. The default action is to do nothing.

preserves.behavior: All git history on the canonical joeharris76/BenchBox repo is preserved (Option B never touched it; this phase doesn't either).
Any external bookmarks to joeharris76/BenchBox continue to work (URL unchanged throughout the migration).

verifications.command: gh pr view <phase-9-pr> --json body --jq '.body' | grep -c '## API surface diff'
verifications.description: Any Phase 9 PR includes the migration API surface diff gate
verifications.expected: >= 1, or this TODO records that no PR was opened

blog posts, slides, papers, social profiles, talks, READMEs of
other projects, etc.

  - github.com/joeharris76/benchbox-private  (was the private)
Update each to point at github.com/joeharris76/BenchBox.
Note: Option B left joeharris76/BenchBox unchanged, so the public
URL was always correct — only references to benchbox-private (which

work_units.summary: Audit external references to old URLs

work_units.notes:
Two reasonable choices:
- DELETE: GitHub UI -> Settings on joeharris76/benchbox-private ->
  Danger zone -> Delete this repository. Irreversible. Frees the
  repo name from your account.
- KEEP: do nothing. The archive sits there forever as a frozen
  historical artefact. Costs zero.
Default to KEEP unless there is a specific reason to delete (e.g.,
embarrassing content discovered post-archive, or repo-name
reclamation needed).
Record the decision in _project/decisions/single-repo-migration.md
as the final entry.

If this phase opens a PR, the PR body must include the API surface
diff section from `_project/specs/migration-api-surface-gate.md`
before this work unit can be marked done. Use explicit `none` rows
when the phase introduces no commands, console scripts, public Python
imports, or file-system conventions.
work_units.summary: Decide: delete the archived benchbox-private GitHub repo, or keep it

rm -rf /Users/joe/Developer/BenchBox.retired-20260427
Default action: delete after w2 confirms no lost work. Costs disk
space; serves no purpose once the archive is verified.
Skip if disk space is fine and you want a permanent local snapshot.
